family: Single sequential frame compiled from a Visual Story Plan into a slide, carousel, or scrollytelling sequence (SLIDES-AND-CAROUSELS.md).
primary_job: Carry one primary information function — orient, assert, show evidence, explain mechanism, compare, qualify, turn, show consequence, or close — as one frame in a beat-ordered sequence (SLIDES-AND-CAROUSELS.md §1).

semantic_density.rationale: One dominant reason for the frame to exist: assertion plus visual evidence plus only the text needed to interpret it (SLIDES-AND-CAROUSELS.md §1-2).

visual_density.rationale: Visible text and chrome vary by density profile (live_narrated, video_frame, silent_carousel, reference_deck) but the default is sparse — a slide reproducing the whole beat is a documented failure (SLIDES-AND-CAROUSELS.md §4, §7, §12 'bullet transcription').

text_policy.complexity_ceiling: Slide titles and citations that must be exact remain deterministic typography even when an illustration is generated; how much visible text is allowed is set by the active density profile, from very-low (video_frame) to medium-to-higher (reference_deck) (SLIDES-AND-CAROUSELS.md §4, §7).

composition.dominant_structure: Primary assertion followed by primary evidence, in that order (Assertion-Evidence profile, SLIDES-AND-CAROUSELS.md §2).
composition.reading_path: Assertion, then evidence, then only the interpreting text needed.
composition.chrome_level: low; layout tokens and responsive behavior belong to the renderer, not the editorial spec (SLIDES-AND-CAROUSELS.md §10)

audience_adaptation.general-reader: silent_carousel-style density: visible text medium, self-contained without narration (SLIDES-AND-CAROUSELS.md §4).
audience_adaptation.professional-generalist: reference_deck-style density: stronger provenance detail, medium-to-higher visible text.
audience_adaptation.domain-expert: reference_deck-style density with lower speaker dependency and denser provenance.
audience_adaptation.beginner-learner: live_narrated or silent_carousel with low visible text and higher narration/self-contained-text dependency, never both omitted at once.

renderer_preference.rule: Exact values rendered from traceable evidence remain deterministic; illustrative frames route through IMAGE-GENERATION.md and its selected visual-language module (SLIDES-AND-CAROUSELS.md §5).

requirements: self-contained without narration when density profile is silent_carousel
mobile legibility is critical for carousel surfaces

readability_gate.rationale: SLIDES-AND-CAROUSELS.md §4 makes mobile legibility a hard requirement of the silent_carousel density profile, and it generalizes the SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §5 mobile-gate principle to sequential frames.

split_rule.rule: One dominant reason per frame. Split a beat into two frames rather than presenting two independent visual questions on one slide — the 'tiny-dashboard slide' failure (SLIDES-AND-CAROUSELS.md §1, §12).

acceptance: the frame's main point can be stated in one sentence
the title/assertion matches the evidence shown
the frame maps to one or more beat_id entries
reject: section-heading deck (article structure copied instead of argument compiled)
voiceover transcript reproduced on screen in a narrated profile
